name: Rebecca Yellowbird
original_name: レベッカ・イエローバード
source:
A village girl from Graybolt.
She's not great at socializing without her mask.
She has a really pretty voice, and all the hunting she does has made her legs crazy muscular.

[From Digital Artwork book]
